Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely equated a Wikipedia snippet saying Androuet du Cerceau was a “supervisor of the royal works” under Henri III with the formal office “Surintendant des Bâtiments du Roi,” without corroboration. This misinterpretation anchored the search on an incorrect official title, despite authoritative evidence (e.g., the Persée article) identifying him as “architecte de la cour de Henri III” (court architect).
